conditions: C6 (tail latency in bundleAt, amended at draft-v4, replaces the draft-v3 C6): Stage 2 publishes three measured constants in mixTuning.ts, each measured on the finished tail by measureTailLatencyS and re-measured by audio:check every run within LATENCY_COMP_TOLERANCE_S 0.5 ms: LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_PATH_S (music onset through glue, safety, both shapers and limiter), LATENCY_COMP_SFX_PATH_S (SFX join through limiter) and their difference LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_VS_SFX_S. The constants are published per context sample rate as a table keyed by 44100 and 48000 (and any rate the soak mirror can render), each entry measured at that rate in an OfflineAudioContext of that rate, none derived from another rate by seconds or by samples; at arming the derivation selects the entry whose key equals ctx.sampleRate, else the nearest key, and the capture overlay names the key used. From Stage 3 on, latencyComp in the bundleAt derivation for every image member is the device term (ctx.outputLatency if finite and positive, else ctx.baseLatency if finite, else 0) plus LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_PATH_S selected as above, sampled once at arming, clamped as a whole to LATENCY_COMP_MAX_S 0.25 s, applied identically to every image member of a bundle so no member is split. Every SFX member of a bundle (today five: playSfx storyAwaken at the a1 unbolt, the a2 FOV liberation and the a4 alive bundle; shipCrash at the crash; storyGlitch at the glitch; the rule binds any bundle that carries a playSfx, not these ids) is scheduled forward by LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_VS_SFX_S so its audible onset lands on the audible music onset the image members target; the offset applies only inside bundleAt scheduling, and the global SFX path, the per-frame SFX queue, the held-level law and unbundled playSfx calls are not delayed, proven by a test that an unbundled playSfx is not shifted. A bundle with no music member (the a4 alive bundle) still uses the summed music-path target for its image and the forward offset for its SFX so the two coincide. The compared quantity is LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_VS_SFX_S, not LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_PATH_S; with forward scheduling in force the residual SFX-versus-image error is the 0.5 ms re-measurement tolerance and the image budget stays: image member visible at frame 0 or +1 against the post-tail envelope-start onset, never at -1, at most +2. If LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_VS_SFX_S at the selected rate ever reaches 16.7 ms, the capture must additionally prove the SFX member and the image member within one frame of each other at every SFX-bearing anchor, or the tail is re-measured and this condition reopens. Evidence: the per-anchor capture overlay's latencyCompMs field reports the summed value, the sample-rate key used and the separate device and music-path terms; the vertical waveform line marks the post-tail music envelope start and at SFX-bearing anchors a second marked line shows the SFX audible onset. Stage 3 captures are covered by this signature only if LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_PATH_S is applied to image members, SFX forward scheduling is present at all five SFX-bearing bundles, and both onset lines appear in the overlay.
